gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-khula: Funnel Display draws its letters like spaghetti, every stroke the same width, so the headline looks traced in one confident line. Khula's tall midsection and open-mouthed curves keep paragraphs moving without fuss.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-krub: Traced with a marker, Funnel Display keeps its strokes uniform. It earns its place big and brief, while Krub, quiet beside it, leaves its loops unfinished beneath a pronounced x-height.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-kufam: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes that bring a headline to life. Kufam does the quieter job, holding a single neon-tube track width with generously open curves in e.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-lexend: Lexend brings outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve. Funnel Display's commanding spaghetti strokes sit over it, and the standout is how a commanding heading hands off to open, plain sans text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-lexend-deca: Funnel Display looks spaghetti-drawn, each stroke holding one width and every c tip stopping well short of touching. Lexend Deca, a sans-serif with unshaded lines and big lowercase, follows without competing.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-liter: Expressive from the first letter, Funnel Display draws its spaghetti-like strokes that never vary in width at all. Liter's job is the text: zero stroke contrast, wide-mouthed rounds, tall presence.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mada: Curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone give the text an approachable, modern feel. Mada supplies all of that beneath Funnel Display, whose glyphs look drawn with one tip, and the split is the point.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans opens every curve generously and holds a high mean line across each word. Martel Sans should read smoothly paragraph after paragraph, with Funnel Display's constant line width staying up top.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-matangi: Spaghetti up top, twine below: Funnel Display draws same-width strokes while Matangi presses open rounded letters flat. And the draw is how a commanding heading rests on a hefty lowercase in plain sans.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-maven-pro: Commanding spaghetti strokes give Funnel Display its headline punch. Maven Pro handles the gentler text work, its sans-serif lowercase high-waisted and its c left welcomingly open, with a soft monotone line.
